cards.title: At the byline
cards.text: You've reached the goal line at a tight angle. A teammate is free in the middle.
cards.tip: From the byline, look for a pull-back to the edge of the six-yard box. It's one of the most dangerous passes in football.

options.text: Pull it back to your teammate
options.why: Your teammate is facing goal with nobody on them. That's a much easier chance.

options.text: Cross high to the far post
options.why: Nobody is there yet, so the ball may just go out.

options.text: Shoot from the tight angle
options.why: The keeper is covering the near post, so there's almost nothing to aim at.

cards.title: Back pass
cards.text: You're the keeper. A teammate passes back to you with their foot and a striker is chasing it.
cards.tip: Keepers need good feet too.

options.text: Pass first time to the free defender
options.why: Quick and safe. Keepers can't pick up a deliberate pass from a teammate's foot.

options.text: Pick it up safely with your hands
options.why: That breaks the rules and gives them a free kick in your box.

options.text: Kick it as far up the pitch as you can
options.why: Safe, but it might give the ball away.

cards.title: Back to goal
cards.text: You receive the ball facing your own goal. A defender is tight behind you.
cards.tip: Check over your shoulder before the ball arrives, so you know what's behind you.

options.text: Spin and try to run past
options.why: The defender is right behind you, so turning here usually loses the ball.

options.text: Pass back to your free teammate
options.why: Play the way you're facing. Your teammate can see the whole pitch and switch the attack.

options.text: Shield the ball and wait
options.why: Good for protecting the ball, but waiting lets more defenders arrive.

cards.title: Back to goal
cards.text: An attacker is receiving the ball with their back to your goal. You're right behind them.
cards.tip: Close enough to touch, but don't foul.

options.text: Tackle through the back of them
options.why: That's a foul and could earn a card.

options.text: Step off and give them space
options.why: Now they can turn and run at you.

options.text: Stay tight so they can't turn
options.why: An attacker facing away from goal isn't dangerous yet. Don't let them turn.

cards.title: Bad call
cards.text: The ref gives a free kick against you. You don't think it was a foul.
cards.tip: Next action is the most important action.

options.text: Stand there and sulk about the call
options.why: The other team will take it quickly while you're switched off.

options.text: Ask the referee calmly what it was for
options.why: Asking politely is fine, but not now. Their free kick is coming, so get organised first.

options.text: Get back into position quickly
options.why: Their free kick is coming either way. Being organised is what helps your team.

cards.title: Ball on its way
cards.text: A pass is coming to you. The nearest defender is a long way off.
cards.tip: Decide what your first touch will do before the ball reaches you.

options.text: Touch it forward into the space
options.why: A forward first touch gets you moving and saves time.

options.text: Hit it first time without looking
options.why: With this much time, a rushed kick usually gives the ball away.

options.text: Stop it dead under your foot
options.why: Safe, but you lose time and the defenders get organised.

cards.title: Beaten
cards.text: An attacker has just got past you and is running towards your goal.
cards.tip: Beaten? Recover. Your next sprint matters most.

options.text: Stop and shout for a teammate to cover
options.why: Talking helps, but stopping takes you out of the game. Shout while you sprint back.

options.text: Pull their shirt to slow them down
options.why: That's a foul, maybe a yellow card, and a free kick in a dangerous place.

options.text: Sprint back towards your own goal
options.why: Getting back between the ball and goal means you can help again.

cards.title: Big-game nerves
cards.text: It's a big match and you feel really nervous.
cards.tip: Nerves mean you care. Use them.

options.text: Hide out wide so you don't get the ball
options.why: Getting involved early is the best way to settle.

options.text: Breathe slowly and plan an easy first pass
options.why: Focusing on one small thing calms your nerves and gets you into the game.

options.text: Go over everything you have to do in your head
options.why: Knowing your job helps, but thinking about too much can make nerves worse. Pick one simple thing.

cards.title: Bigger opponents
cards.text: The other team are all much bigger than your team.
cards.tip: Play to your strengths.

options.text: Give up, they're far too big
options.why: Size isn't everything in football.

options.text: Avoid all of the challenges
options.why: Sensible sometimes, but you still need to compete.

options.text: Use quick passing and movement
options.why: Speed and smart passing beat size.

cards.title: Change of pace
cards.text: You're dribbling and a defender is standing square in front of you. Your winger is marked.
cards.tip: Slow, slow, FAST. A change of speed beats defenders.

options.text: Fake one way, then burst the other
options.why: A fake makes the defender shift their weight. A sudden change of speed takes you past.

options.text: Dribble slowly straight at them
options.why: At one speed you're easy to tackle.

options.text: Pass to the marked winger
options.why: Not a disaster, but the defender out wide is right on them.

cards.title: Corner against you
cards.text: The other team has a corner. You're marking their tallest player.
cards.tip: At set pieces, know your job and stick to it.

options.text: Watch the corner taker as they kick it
options.why: Your player can run off you and get a free shot at goal.

options.text: Stay tight and goal-side, see both
options.why: Stay touch-tight and keep ball and player in view. Then they can't get a free run at the ball.

options.text: Leave them and go and stand on the post
options.why: Useful, but your player is now completely free.

cards.title: Corner kick
cards.text: You're taking a corner. Your teammates are waiting around the penalty spot and the keeper is on the line.
cards.tip: Pick a target area before you take the corner.

options.text: Whip it in towards the penalty spot
options.why: That's where your teammates are, and it's too far out for the keeper to come and catch easily.

options.text: Float it high into the six-yard box
options.why: A slow, high ball close to goal is easy for the keeper to catch.

options.text: Play it short along the ground
options.why: Can work, but only if a teammate comes over for it. Right now nobody is there.

cards.title: Counter-attack
cards.text: You've just won the ball. It's three of you against two defenders.
cards.tip: On the counter: be fast, be direct, keep the last pass simple.

options.text: Slow down and wait for support
options.why: Counters work because the other team isn't set. Waiting gives them time.

options.text: Run at them, then pass to whoever's free
options.why: Driving forward forces a defender to step up, which leaves a teammate free.

options.text: Pass it out wide straight away
options.why: Fine, but running at them first drags a defender with you.

cards.title: Cover your teammate
cards.text: Your teammate is closing down the player with the ball. You're nearby.
cards.tip: Pressure and cover: one goes, one supports.

options.text: Cover behind your teammate at an angle
options.why: If the attacker beats your teammate, you're there next.

options.text: Stay where you are and keep watching it
options.why: Not terrible, but you're too far away to help if your teammate gets beaten.

options.text: Run at the ball to help them out
options.why: Two of you on one player leaves another attacker free.

cards.title: Cross incoming
cards.text: The other team is about to cross. Their striker is next to you in the box.
cards.tip: In your own box, the striker is your job.

options.text: Run out wide to block the crosser
options.why: That leaves the striker free right in front of goal.

options.text: Watch only the ball as it comes in
options.why: You might win it, but the striker can sneak in front of you.

options.text: Stay goal-side, see ball and striker
options.why: From there you can attack the ball and the striker can't get in front of you.

cards.title: Crossing time
cards.text: You're wide on the right near the box. Your striker is making a run to the near post.
cards.tip: Look up before you cross so you know where your runners are.

options.text: Shoot at the near post from out wide
options.why: The angle is too tight. Your striker is in a much better spot.

options.text: Float a high cross over to the far post
options.why: Can work, but gives the keeper time to come and claim it.

options.text: Whip it low across the six-yard box
options.why: Low, fast crosses are hard for keepers to catch and easy for strikers to tap in.

cards.title: Cut-back danger
cards.text: An attacker has reached your byline. Another attacker is running into the middle. You're sprinting back.
cards.tip: When the ball goes wide, protect the middle.

options.text: Block the pull-back in front of goal
options.why: Pull-backs are the danger. You need to be between that runner and the ball.

options.text: Jog back slowly and watch the ball
options.why: The runner will beat you to it.

options.text: Run across to help on the ball
options.why: Your teammate is already there. Now the runner is free.

cards.title: Defender in the way
cards.text: A defender is right in front of you. Your teammate is just to the side.
cards.tip: Pass and move. Never pass and watch.

options.text: Pass to your teammate, then stay put
options.why: You keep the ball, but your teammate has nobody to pass to next.

options.text: Dribble straight into the defender
options.why: They're set and waiting for you. A pass is quicker than any trick.

options.text: Pass and run past for the return
options.why: A one-two gets you past the defender without having to beat them.

cards.title: Dummy
cards.text: A low cross is coming to you, but a defender is right behind you. Your teammate is free just behind you.
cards.tip: Sometimes the best touch is no touch.

options.text: Let it run through to your teammate
options.why: Your dummy fools the defender, and your teammate gets a free shot.

options.text: Control it, even with the defender on you
options.why: You might keep it, but the defender will be all over you.

options.text: Stop it dead and wait for help
options.why: The defender will nick it straight away.

cards.title: Edge of the box
cards.text: You're just outside the box with space to shoot. Defenders are behind you and the box is crowded.
cards.tip: If you can see the goal and nobody's blocking, shoot.

options.text: Shoot now, while you have space
options.why: A clear sight of goal doesn't last. Take the shot before the defenders behind you catch up.

options.text: Pass sideways to your teammate
options.why: Safe, but they're further out and wider. You have the better chance.

options.text: Dribble into the crowded box
options.why: There are two defenders waiting in there. You'll lose the space you have now.

cards.title: Find the gap
cards.text: Your teammate has the ball behind you. You're a midfielder looking to receive it.
cards.tip: Move to where your teammate can see you and pass to you.

options.text: Move between their midfield and defence
options.why: In that pocket you can receive the ball and turn to face goal.

options.text: Stand just behind their midfielder
options.why: Your teammate can't pass to you with someone in the way.

options.text: Run right up next to their defenders
options.why: You might get a ball over the top, but it's much harder to receive and turn there.

cards.title: Free kick
cards.text: You have a free kick just outside the box. There's a wall of three, and the keeper is standing to one side.
cards.tip: Look at the wall and the keeper before you decide.

options.text: Quick short pass to your free teammate
options.why: Can catch defenders napping, but you'd lose a good shooting chance.

options.text: Aim over the wall into the open side
options.why: The keeper has moved across, leaving one side of the goal more open.

options.text: Smash it hard and straight at goal
options.why: That's where the wall is. It'll most likely be blocked.

cards.title: Goal kick
cards.text: You're taking a goal kick. Their forwards are waiting on halfway to press, but one of your defenders is free on the right.
cards.tip: Building from the back starts with finding the free player.

options.text: Pass to the teammate in the middle
options.why: There are opponents right around them. Losing it here could mean a goal.

options.text: Kick it as far as you can
options.why: Safe from danger, but it's often a 50-50 that hands them the ball.

options.text: Pass short to your free defender
options.why: An easy pass to a free teammate keeps the ball and beats their press.

cards.title: Half-time, losing badly
cards.text: It's half-time and your team is losing. Some teammates are arguing.
cards.tip: One thing to fix, together.

options.text: Calm them down and agree one thing to fix
options.why: A team that sticks together can come back. Arguing just makes it worse.

options.text: Sit away from everyone and stay quiet
options.why: Avoids trouble, but your team needs you.

options.text: Join in and tell them who's to blame
options.why: More shouting splits the team further.

cards.title: Hard foul
cards.text: An opponent fouls your teammate badly.
cards.tip: Keep your head when others lose theirs.

options.text: Get your own back with a hard foul later
options.why: You could get sent off, and the team suffers.

options.text: Stay calm and let the ref deal with it
options.why: The ref handles fouls. Staying calm keeps your team at full strength.

options.text: Calmly ask the ref to watch that player
options.why: Fair to mention once and calmly, but it's the ref's job. Then forget it and play.

cards.title: Header chance
cards.text: A cross is coming towards your head near the goal.
cards.tip: Eyes open, use your forehead, aim down.

options.text: Head it down towards the corner
options.why: Downward headers bounce awkwardly and are hard for keepers.

options.text: Let it hit you and hope it goes in
options.why: Attack the ball. Don't let it attack you.

options.text: Head it straight towards goal
options.why: On target, but probably right at the keeper.

cards.title: High cross
cards.text: You're the keeper. A high cross is coming into a crowded box.
cards.tip: Keepers: be loud, be decisive.

options.text: Punch it clear, away from the crowd
options.why: A good choice if it's too busy to catch, but the ball may come straight back.

options.text: Stay on your goal line and wait
options.why: The attackers get a free go at the ball.

options.text: Shout "Keeper!" and catch it high
options.why: Calling tells your team you're coming. Catching it high is above everyone else.

cards.title: Hold the line
cards.text: Your other defenders have stepped up. You've stayed back, which keeps their striker onside.
cards.tip: Defend as a line, not alone. (Check whether your league uses offside.)

options.text: Stay deep behind your teammates
options.why: You're keeping the striker onside, and they can get in behind.

options.text: Step up in line with your teammates
options.why: A straight line can catch the striker offside and keeps your back line together.

options.text: Run out to the player on the ball
options.why: Pressure helps, but now there's a gap in your line.

cards.title: In your box
cards.text: An attacker is dribbling across your box, looking for a shot.
cards.tip: In your box: stay up, stay patient.

options.text: Slide in from the side to win it
options.why: Miss the ball and it's a penalty.

options.text: Stay on your feet and goal-side
options.why: A foul in your box can give away a penalty. Stay between them and goal.

options.text: Back off towards the six-yard box
options.why: Gives them room to shoot.

cards.title: Keeper off the line
cards.text: You're on the ball in midfield and notice the keeper is standing way out of goal.
cards.tip: Always know where the keeper is standing.

options.text: Blast it low at goal
options.why: A shot on target can still go in, so it's not a bad idea. But the keeper is out in its path, so going over is better.

options.text: Pass forward to a teammate
options.why: Fine, but you'd miss a rare chance to catch the keeper out.

options.text: Chip it over the keeper
options.why: With the keeper so far out, a lofted shot over their head is the quickest way to score.

cards.title: Keeper one-on-one
cards.text: You're the keeper. An attacker is through on goal with nobody else near.
cards.tip: Big, brave, patient: let the attacker blink first.

options.text: Dive at their feet as early as you can
options.why: Go down too early and they just go round you or chip you.

options.text: Come out, stay big and on your feet
options.why: Coming out shrinks the goal they can see. Staying up makes them choose first.

options.text: Stay on your goal line and wait
options.why: Gives them the whole goal to aim at.

cards.title: Last defender
cards.text: An attacker is running at you with the ball. Your teammates are racing back.
cards.tip: Side-on, knees bent, eyes on the ball, not on their tricks.

options.text: Stay on your feet and slow them down
options.why: Jockeying buys time for your teammates to get back. Make the attacker make the decision.

options.text: Dive in with a quick slide tackle
options.why: If you miss, they're through on goal. Stay patient.

options.text: Drop back towards the edge of your box
options.why: Backing off buys a little time, but go too far and they get a shot from the edge. Slow them down further out.

cards.title: Let it go out
cards.text: The ball is rolling out over your goal line. It last touched an attacker, and another attacker is chasing it.
cards.tip: Know when to let the ball go out.

options.text: Turn and try to dribble out
options.why: Risky right next to your goal.

options.text: Shield it until it rolls out
options.why: Your body keeps the attacker away until it's out, and you get the ball back.

options.text: Clear it away up the line
options.why: Fine, but you'd give up a free goal kick.

cards.title: Mine or yours?
cards.text: A ball is bouncing between you and your keeper. A striker is chasing it.
cards.tip: Talk. "Keeper's!" or "Away!" stops mix-ups.

options.text: Leave it and hope the keeper gets it
options.why: The striker could nip in.

options.text: Run for it without saying anything
options.why: You might get there, but you could crash into your keeper.

options.text: Call loudly so only one of you goes
options.why: A loud, early call means only one of you goes for it.

cards.title: Missed chance
cards.text: Your teammate misses an easy chance in front of goal.
cards.tip: Good teammates make each other braver.

options.text: Say nothing and get on with the game
options.why: Better than shouting, but a quick word of support helps a lot.

options.text: Encourage them: "Next one!"
options.why: A player who feels backed is more likely to score the next chance.

options.text: Shout at them to do better
options.why: It knocks their confidence and doesn't help the team.

cards.title: Muddy pitch
cards.text: It's pouring with rain and the pitch is slippery.
cards.tip: Adapt to the conditions.

options.text: Kick it long so it doesn't get stuck
options.why: It can skip over the puddles, but long balls are hard to control. Keep it simple and safe.

options.text: Try lots of fancy skills and tricks
options.why: The ball will skid away from you.

options.text: Keep passes and touches simple
options.why: Slippery conditions make tricks hard. Simple football works best.

cards.title: Never passes
cards.text: One teammate keeps the ball every time and never passes to you.
cards.tip: Make yourself easy to find.

options.text: Stop running for it, they won't pass
options.why: Then they'll never pass to you.

options.text: Keep moving into space and call for it
options.why: It makes the pass easier to see. Keep offering.

options.text: Have a calm word with them after the game
options.why: A good idea, but keep helping during the match too.

cards.title: Offside?
cards.text: You're the striker. Your teammate is about to pass, but you're already past the last defender.
cards.tip: Onside when the pass is played, then GO. (Many junior leagues don't use offside yet.)

options.text: Step back level, then run as they pass
options.why: Being level when the pass is played keeps you onside. Then you can run in behind.

options.text: Drop deep to get the ball to feet
options.why: Keeps you onside, but you lose the chance to get in behind.

options.text: Stay where you are and call for it
options.why: If they pass now, you're offside and the other team gets a free kick.

cards.title: Open grass ahead
cards.text: You've got the ball in midfield. Nobody is in front of you.
cards.tip: Big touches when it's open, small touches when it's busy.

options.text: Dribble forward into the space
options.why: Running with the ball into space drags defenders out of position.

options.text: Pass to your teammate on the right
options.why: They have a defender right on them, so the pass will probably be cut out.

options.text: Pass back to your defender
options.why: Safe, but you waste the chance to attack while the space is there.

cards.title: Outnumbered
cards.text: Two attackers are coming at you. You're the only defender back.
cards.tip: Outnumbered? Delay, delay, delay.

options.text: Stay between them and slow them down
options.why: Delaying gives teammates time to recover, and the attackers might make a mistake.

options.text: Mark the player without the ball
options.why: The ball carrier can then run in and shoot.

options.text: Run at the player with the ball
options.why: They'll just pass to the free attacker.

cards.title: Overlap
cards.text: You've got the ball on the wing and a defender is in front of you. Your teammate is sprinting round the outside.
cards.tip: A teammate making a run deserves a pass, or at least a look.

options.text: Hold it until the defender tackles
options.why: Waiting gives the defender time and wastes your teammate's run.

options.text: Pass into your teammate's path
options.why: The defender can't mark both of you. Your teammate gets in behind.

options.text: Try to beat the defender yourself
options.why: Possible, but you're ignoring a teammate who's already free.

cards.title: Penalty
cards.text: You've put the ball on the spot. The keeper is bouncing on the line, trying to put you off.
cards.tip: Pick your spot, breathe, and don't change your mind.

options.text: Change your mind as you run up
options.why: Last-second changes make your body unsure, and the shot usually ends up weak.

options.text: Just blast it hard, with no aim
options.why: Power can beat a keeper, but without a target it often flies over or straight at them.

options.text: Pick a corner early and stick to it
options.why: Deciding early means a confident strike. Changing your mind mid run-up leads to scuffed kicks.

cards.title: Player down
cards.text: An opponent is lying on the ground hurt. Your team has the ball and play is still going.
cards.tip: Respect first, always.

options.text: Keep attacking while the player is still down
options.why: Winning matters less than someone being hurt.

options.text: Stop and stand still until someone notices
options.why: Kindly meant, but the referee might not have seen. Tell them, or kick it out.

options.text: Stop and tell the referee, or kick it out
options.why: Their safety comes first. The referee can stop the game so they get help.

cards.title: Pressed in your box
cards.text: You have the ball near your own box and two attackers are closing in fast.
cards.tip: Under pressure near your goal: safe first.

options.text: Dribble across your own box
options.why: Losing it here would give them a free shot.

options.text: Pass back to your keeper
options.why: Your keeper is free, and it relieves the pressure safely.

options.text: Kick it out over the touchline
options.why: Safe, but you give the ball away close to your goal.

cards.title: Pressing their defender
cards.text: Their defender has the ball near their own goal. You're the closest player.
cards.tip: Press with your body angled to block the pass you don't want them to make.

options.text: Sprint straight at them to rush them
options.why: Puts them under pressure, but they can simply pass round you.

options.text: Stand still and wait for a mistake
options.why: It gives them time to pick the perfect pass.

options.text: Curve your run to block the easy pass
options.why: A curved run cuts off one option, pushing them towards your teammates or a long hopeful kick.

cards.title: Pressure from one side
cards.text: A pass is coming to you. A defender is rushing in from your left. There's space on your right.
cards.tip: Know where the pressure is coming from before the ball arrives.

options.text: Take your first touch to the left
options.why: That takes the ball straight towards the defender.

options.text: First touch away to your right
options.why: Taking the ball away from pressure gives you time and space.

options.text: Pass it straight back first time
options.why: Safe, but you had space to turn into.

cards.title: Quick free kick
cards.text: You've been fouled in midfield. The other team have turned away and are chatting.
cards.tip: Be the first to switch back on after a stoppage.

options.text: Take it quickly to a free teammate
options.why: While they're switched off, a quick free kick can set up a big chance.

options.text: Wait until everyone is set and ready
options.why: Fine, but you lose the surprise.

options.text: Argue with the player who fouled you
options.why: You waste the chance and might get a card.

cards.title: Rebound
cards.text: The keeper saves a shot but the ball bounces loose near you.
cards.tip: Always follow your teammates' shots in.

options.text: Wait to see if the ref gives a corner
options.why: The ball is still in play. Strikers who follow up score the most tap-ins.

options.text: React fast and shoot first time
options.why: The keeper is on the floor. Hit it before they get up.

options.text: Control it, look up, shoot
options.why: Calm, but every second lets the keeper and defenders recover.

cards.title: Runner in behind
cards.text: Your teammate starts sprinting past the defenders.
cards.tip: Watch your teammates' runs, not only the ball.

options.text: Shoot now, before the defenders close in
options.why: It's too far out with three defenders in the way.

options.text: Play it short to your teammate's feet
options.why: They'd have to stop running, and the defenders would catch up.

options.text: Pass into the space ahead of them
options.why: Passing into space lets your teammate run onto it without slowing down.

cards.title: Runner on your blind side
cards.text: Your teammate is closing down the ball. A striker starts a run behind you.
cards.tip: See ball, see player. Keep both in view.

options.text: Follow the runner and stay goal-side
options.why: The runner is the danger. If you stay between them and goal, the pass is no use.

options.text: Keep your eyes fixed on the ball
options.why: Ball-watching is how runners get in behind you.

options.text: Close in to help your teammate win it
options.why: Two on the ball might win it, but the runner is then free behind you. Only go if someone else has them.

cards.title: Running out of time
cards.text: Five minutes left and your team is losing.
cards.tip: Stay calm, play quicker, keep believing.

options.text: Give up, there's no time left now
options.why: Plenty of games turn around in the last five minutes.

options.text: Kick it long into their box every time
options.why: Sometimes works, but mostly gives the ball away.

options.text: Keep playing your way, only quicker
options.why: Calm, quick passing creates chances. Panic doesn't.

cards.title: Scramble in the box
cards.text: The ball is bouncing around in your box with attackers close by.
cards.tip: In your own box: if in doubt, kick it out.

options.text: Try to dribble out of the box
options.why: Lose it here and it's a goal. Keep it simple.

options.text: Clear it straight up the middle
options.why: Gets it away, but it might land at an opponent's feet in front of goal.

options.text: Clear it high and out wide
options.why: High and wide gets it away from danger and out of the middle.

cards.title: Shot coming
cards.text: An attacker is about to shoot from the edge of your box. You're between them and goal.
cards.tip: Brave defending: stay on your feet and get in the way.

options.text: Turn your back and jump out of the way
options.why: The ball goes straight past you towards goal.

options.text: Get your body in the way, side-on
options.why: Blocking the shot is brave and stops danger. Side-on keeps your arms tucked in.

options.text: Slide in to block at the last second
options.why: It might block it, but you risk a foul or a penalty.

cards.title: Skill gone wrong
cards.text: You tried a new skill in a match and lost the ball.
cards.tip: Brave, but smart: right skill, right moment.

options.text: Keep trying it when the moment is right
options.why: Every good player failed loads while learning. Pick a better moment next time.

options.text: Try it every time you get the ball
options.why: Skills work when they fit the situation. Choosing when is the real skill.

options.text: Never try that skill in a match again
options.why: Then you'll never get good at it.

cards.title: Speedy attacker
cards.text: The attacker coming at you is much faster than you.
cards.tip: Against speed, use distance and angles.

options.text: Give yourself a few steps of space
options.why: Then they can't knock it past and outrun you.

options.text: Dive in early before they get going
options.why: You might win it, but if you miss they're gone.

options.text: Stand really close to block their path
options.why: They'll knock it past and sprint away.

cards.title: Stay wide
cards.text: You're the right winger. The ball is on the left and you've drifted into the middle where it's crowded.
cards.tip: When your team has the ball, make the pitch big.

options.text: Run over to the ball to help
options.why: That squeezes everyone into one area and makes it easy to defend.

options.text: Stay where you are in the middle
options.why: You're not in the way, but you're not adding anything either.

options.text: Move back out wide on the right
options.why: Staying wide stretches the defence and gives your team an option to switch play.

cards.title: Subbed off
cards.text: The coach takes you off and you thought you were playing well.
cards.tip: Everyone gets subbed. How you handle it is the key.

options.text: Cheer on your team, ask the coach later
options.why: Supporting your team and learning from it shows great character.

options.text: Sit quietly on the bench and watch
options.why: Fine, but cheering helps your team.

options.text: Kick a water bottle in frustration
options.why: It upsets the team and the coach.

cards.title: Tackled
cards.text: You've just lost the ball in midfield.
cards.tip: Lose it, react: five seconds of hard pressing.

options.text: Complain to the referee about the tackle
options.why: The game doesn't stop. While you complain, they attack.

options.text: Drop back into your position to defend
options.why: Getting back into shape is sensible, but the first few seconds are the best time to win it back.

options.text: Press straight away to win it back
options.why: The best time to win the ball back is the first few seconds after losing it.

cards.title: Teammate in a better spot
cards.text: You're in a good area, but two defenders are blocking your shot. Your teammate is free in the middle.
cards.tip: The best players know when to shoot and when to pass.

options.text: Pass to your teammate in the middle
options.why: They have a clear view of goal. Setting up a goal is as good as scoring one.

options.text: Shoot through the defenders
options.why: It will almost certainly be blocked.

options.text: Dribble wide to find space
options.why: You might find an angle, but the chance in the middle could disappear.

cards.title: Their keeper's ball
cards.text: You're a striker. Their keeper has the ball and wants to pass to a defender.
cards.tip: Strikers are the first defenders.

options.text: Curve your run to block one pass
options.why: You stop one option and push the keeper to the other side, where your teammates can press.

options.text: Walk back to the halfway line
options.why: It gives them an easy start.

options.text: Sprint straight at the keeper
options.why: Puts them under pressure, but they can pass either way.

cards.title: Their throw-in or pass-in
cards.text: The other team has a throw-in or pass-in near your box. The nearest attacker is close to you.
cards.tip: Set pieces count too. Switch on.

options.text: Watch the player taking it
options.why: Your attacker can get free while you're looking.

options.text: Get tight and goal-side of them
options.why: A throw-in or pass-in is an easy pass for them, so make it hard to receive.

options.text: Stand back to give yourself room
options.why: They can receive and turn easily.

cards.title: Through on goal
cards.text: You've beaten the last defender. Only the keeper is left, and a defender is chasing back.
cards.tip: Glance at where the keeper is standing before you strike, then aim for the bigger gap.

options.text: Stop and wait for a teammate
options.why: Stopping lets the defender recover. Chances like this don't last.

options.text: Dribble round the keeper
options.why: It can work, but every extra touch gives the chasing defender time to get back.

options.text: Shoot low into a corner
options.why: Low shots into the corners are the hardest for a keeper to reach. Shoot early, before the defender catches you.

cards.title: Throw-in
cards.text: You're taking a throw-in. One teammate is close and free. Another is further away with a defender on them.
cards.tip: Throw-ins are a free pass. Don't waste them.

options.text: Throw it down the line for a chase
options.why: Can work, but often gives the ball back to the other team.

options.text: Throw it long to the marked teammate
options.why: The defender is right there and will probably win it.

options.text: Throw to the free teammate's feet
options.why: A short, easy throw keeps the ball. Feet are easier to control than a bouncing ball at head height.

cards.title: Too crowded
cards.text: You have the ball on the left. Lots of players are packed around you. Your winger on the far side is completely free.
cards.tip: If it's busy, look at the other side of the pitch.

options.text: Switch it to the free winger
options.why: When one side is crowded, the other side is open. A switch moves the whole game.

options.text: Pass back to your teammate behind
options.why: Keeps the ball, and they might be able to switch it. But you could do it now.

options.text: Keep dribbling down the left side
options.why: Three defenders are close. You'll run out of space fast.

cards.title: Trapped on the wing
cards.text: You're near the touchline and two defenders are closing you down.
cards.tip: When it's crowded, look where the defenders came from. That's where the space is now.

options.text: Kick it long down the line
options.why: It gets you out of trouble, but you're likely to give the ball away.

options.text: Try to dribble past both
options.why: Beating two players in a tight space is really hard. You'll probably lose it.

options.text: Pass inside to your free teammate
options.why: Two defenders on you means someone else is free. Find them.

cards.title: Two against one
cards.text: You and a teammate are attacking. There's one defender between you.
cards.tip: In a 2v1, attack the defender so they have to pick one of you.

options.text: Shoot early from where you are
options.why: It's a long way out with a defender in the way. You have a better option.

options.text: Pass to your teammate straight away
options.why: Not bad, but the defender can just shift across. Draw them in first.

options.text: Run at them, pass when they commit
options.why: Making the defender choose leaves your teammate free. Pass the moment they commit to you.

cards.title: Weaker foot
cards.text: You have a chance to shoot, but the ball is on your weaker foot. A defender is closing in from your strong side.
cards.tip: Practise with both feet so you never have to choose.

options.text: Touch it onto your stronger foot
options.why: Your stronger foot gives a cleaner strike, but the touch moves you towards the defender. Only do it if there's room.

options.text: Pass to your teammate nearby
options.why: They have a defender nearby too. You have the clearer chance.

options.text: Shoot with your weaker foot
options.why: A quick shot with your weaker foot beats a perfect one that gets blocked.

cards.title: Which way?
cards.text: You're facing an attacker in the middle of the pitch. They could go either way.
cards.tip: Pick a side and show them where you want them to go.

options.text: Back off and let them cut inside
options.why: Inside is the shortest route to goal and opens up a shot.

options.text: Stand side-on, show them the touchline
options.why: The wing is less dangerous, and the touchline acts like an extra defender.

options.text: Stand square right in front of them
options.why: Better than nothing, but they can go either way past you.

cards.title: Winning easily
cards.text: Your team is winning comfortably.
cards.tip: Win well, lose well.

options.text: Keep playing properly and respect them
options.why: Playing the right way is how you keep improving, and it shows respect.

options.text: Stop trying now the game is won
options.why: You lose the chance to practise.

options.text: Show off tricks to embarrass them
options.why: Disrespectful and how injuries and fights start.

cards.title: Winning, one minute left
cards.text: Your team is 2–1 up with a minute to go. You have the ball near their corner flag.
cards.tip: Know the score and the time. They change the best decision. At youth level, going for another goal is fine too.

options.text: Cross it into the box straight away
options.why: Nobody is there, so you'd hand them the ball and a chance to attack.

options.text: Shield it by the corner flag
options.why: Every second the ball stays there is a second they can't attack you.

options.text: Pass it back to your teammate
options.why: Keeps the ball, but brings play back towards your own goal.

cards.title: You scored!
cards.text: You've just scored a great goal.
cards.tip: Enjoy it, then refocus.

options.text: Skip the celebration and run straight back
options.why: Staying switched on is right, but enjoy it with your team first. Celebrating together lifts everyone.

options.text: Show off in front of the other team
options.why: It's disrespectful and fires them up.

options.text: Celebrate with your team, then get ready
options.why: Teams often concede right after scoring because they switch off.

cards.title: Your mistake
cards.text: Your mistake has just led to a goal for the other team.
cards.tip: Mistake, reset, go again.

options.text: Shake it off, focus on the next action
options.why: Mistakes happen to everyone. The next action is the one you can control.

options.text: Keep out of the way so you can't do it again
options.why: Your team needs you involved.

options.text: Go and say sorry to your keeper and team
options.why: Owning up is good, but keep it quick. Say "My fault", then get your head back in the game.
